# rgb-lib-wasm fixtures

Raw values of `@utexo/rgb-lib-wasm` 1.0.0-beta.5, kept exactly as the runtime
builds them: `bigint`, `Map` and keys set to `undefined` included. Decoders are tested against these, not only against the handwritten
fake.

| File                                        | Source                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `rgb-lib-wasm-1.0.0-beta.5/<method>.mjs`    | captured: one module per `WasmWallet` method (and `invoiceData`): every distinct shape (paths with their kinds), then more samples up to 4                                         |
| `rgb-lib-wasm-1.0.0-beta.5/errors.mjs`      | captured: runtime rejection messages                                                                                                                                               |
| `rgb-lib-wasm-1.0.0-beta.5/handmade.mjs`    | handmade: shapes the stand cannot produce (media, a BFA asset, an EVM reject list, refresh failures, absent buckets); `meta.rustCommit` names the Rust source of the shapes        |
| `rgb-lib-wasm-1.0.0-beta.5/negative.mjs`    | handmade: missing fields, wrong containers, unknown variants and keys, boundary numbers (u64, i64, u8, u32, i32), nested errors with BigInt; each with the expected strict outcome |
| `error-texts/rgb-lib-wasm-1.0.0-beta.5.mjs` | generated by `npm run errors:generate` from the Rust source: every error text and the code it must get                                                                             |
| `source.mjs`                                | `toSource` (lossless text form) and `describeTypes`                                                                                                                                |
| `lib.mjs`                                   | helpers for handmade samples                                                                                                                                                       |

Each captured module records the runtime version, the wasm SHA-256, the
capture time and, per sample, the kind at every path.

## Commands

```bash
npm run capture:fixtures  # rerun the capture; needs the regtest stand (tests/e2e/README.md)
npm run golden:update     # rewrite tests/golden/*.golden.mjs from the current code
RGB_LIB_WASM_SRC=<rgb-lib-wasm checkout at v1.0.0-beta.5> npm run errors:generate  # or errors:check
```

- `tests/unit/fixtures.test.mjs` fails when the installed runtime differs from
  the captured one (version or wasm hash): capture again before upgrading.
- `tests/unit/golden.test.mjs` runs every sample through the built engine and
  compares the public result, the error and the runtime calls with the golden
  file. Its `KNOWN_DEFECTS` list names where the current code differs from the
  strict rules in `negative.mjs`; it is empty.

The capture fails, before it removes anything, on a value `toSource` cannot
keep exactly (a sparse array, a null-prototype object, a class instance). The
capture replaces all captured modules and keeps `handmade.mjs` and
`negative.mjs`. Captured values change between runs (txids, timestamps), so a
recapture rewrites the golden file too; review both diffs.

Fee estimation needs fee data in the stand's esplora node: bitcoind drops
estimates older than 60 hours. On a stand that was stopped for days, send a
few transactions per block for about ten blocks, waiting for them to reach
the esplora node before each block, then capture.
